name: Benfica 2013/14
scopeNote: Benfica under Jorge Jesus, 2013/14 domestic treble (Primeira Liga, Taça da Liga final 7 May 2014, Taça de Portugal final 18 May 2014) and Europa League runner-up (0-0 Sevilla, 2-4 pens, 14 May 2014). Period: first match Marítimo 2-1 Benfica 18 Aug 2013 (RTP); last match Taça de Portugal final 18 May 2014 (Wikipedia); Benfica entered the Champions League at the group stage, no qualification rounds found. Sources call the system 4-4-2 / diamond (Coaches' Voice, retrospective) and a 4-2-3-1 / 4-3-3 switch in the Europa League rounds (Bleacher Report 2014); the defence is described as exclusively zonal (Bola na Rede). Popular reading of Jesus as only attacking is nuanced by the 2014 defensive turn (2 goals conceded in 17 games from 15 Dec 2013). Many search-summary claims (squad age, Sevilla final details, Gaitan/Salvio roles) were not found on mined pages and are left out. Coaches' Voice entries are a 2020 retrospective on Jesus's first Benfica reign (2009-15) dated 2013/14 for convenience; Enzo Perez re-positioning dates from Aug 2012 (unverified, outside period).
openQuestions: No tier A in-period tactical study found; Coaches' Voice profile is a 2020 retrospective covering 2009-15 Benfica.
Formation disagreement: Bola na Rede 2022 mentions 5-2-1-2 under Jesus (retrospective, unverified for 2013/14); Bleacher Report says 4-2-3-1/4-3-3; Coaches' Voice says 4-4-2/diamond.
Squad age not evidenced from mined pages.
Whether the Taça da Liga or Taça de Portugal opening ties preceded 18 Aug 2013 was not checked; Supertaça 2013 did not involve Benfica (not verified).
Jesus quote on defending is attributed via Bola na Rede, video source not opened (timestamp 1:14:45).
